name: QuaTorch
description: **QuaTorch** is a lightweight python package providing Quaternion, a `torch.Tensor` subclass that represents a [Quaternion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternion). It implements `torch.compile`-able operations for quaternions such as multiplication, conjugation, inversion, normalization, log, exp, etc. It also supports conversion to/from rotation matrix and axis-angle representation. Convenient utilities are provided together, such as spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) and 3D vector rotation.
